pages.title: Refining Unit
pages.text: The Refining Unit processes materials at high temperature — refining ores into powders or plants into extracts.$(br2)Power: 5 $(efu)$(br)Speed: 1 item per 2 seconds$(br)Clearance: 3x3
Check the exact recipe in the Crafter. Required materials can be looked up in REI/JEI.
